chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Hisham ibn al-Hakam, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'Let one of you adorn himself on the day of Friday by washing, applying perfume, combing his beard, and wearing the cleanest of his clothes. Let him prepare for Friday, and let tranquility and dignity be upon him during that day. Let him perform good worship of his Lord, and let him do good as much as he is able, for Allah looks upon the people of the earth to multiply the good deeds.'

key_terms.لِيُحْسِنْ عِبَادَةَ رَبِّهِ: To perform good worship of his Lord

ai.seo_question: What are the recommended acts of preparation and etiquette for Friday according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records Imam al-Sadiq (AS) linking physical purification (ghusl, perfume, grooming) with spiritual tranquility (sakina), reflecting the Shia emphasis on Friday as a day of communal and individual spiritual renewal. This preparation is not merely aesthetic but a form of worship that invites divine attention, as Allah surveys the earth to multiply rewards for the faithful.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus Bin Abdul Rahman, from Hisham Bin Al Hakam who said,

‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘In order for one of you to adorn on the day of Friday, he should wash and apply perfume, and comb his beard, and wear the cleanest of his clothes and be prepared for the Friday, and let there be the tranquillity and the dignity upon him during that day, and let him do good worship of his Lord<sup>azwj</sup>, and let him do the goodness whatever he is capable of, for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> has Notified upon the people of the earth He<sup>azwj</sup> would be Multiplying the good deeds’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Yunus ibn ‘Abd al-Rahman from Hisham ibn al-Hakam who has said the following:

“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘Everyone of you should take a shower, apply fragrance, comb your beard, dress up in your best dress and prepare himself for Friday. On that day, he should be serene and dignified. He should make his worshipping his Lord to be the best and do as much good as he can; Allah watches over the people of earth to double their good deeds.”’
